program_track: T3 (unified_architecture_program) I38 slice 1, amended I41 slice 2, (f) re-adjudicated under the T1 schema-ownership option 2026-07-27
description: Ratchet allowlist for tests/architecture/governance/test_cpp_include_direction.py. Each entry is a pre-existing include-direction violation identified by an exact (file, line, include spelling) fingerprint. The 2026-08-13 execution-controller retirement closed the engine-to-mission controller edge and the runtime-contracts-to-mission step-request edge; both stale entries were removed. The remaining entries are GPU/engine integration seams.

entries.owner: T3 physical link-unit split (re-evaluated I41, deferred; design-gap pointer: T4 exact-runtime alignment)
entries.next_gate: Design the GPU/engine integration seam (opaque packet handle or callback injection) called out by the T3 track's 'link order and initialization' risk before WorldBatchRuntime can stop including gpu/* directly.
entries.reason: WorldBatchRuntime's interaction-broadphase compatibility path (run_interaction_broadphase_candidate_ids and callers) calls gpu::InteractionBroadphaseConfig/InteractionEntityPacked/InteractionQueryPacked and gpu::build_interaction_broadphase_*_batch directly; engine owns the call, inverting the src/README top-level direction note ('gpu -> core/runtime data packets ... no ownership of canonical world-step truth'). Re-evaluated at I41 (T3 second slice): confirmed a genuine design gap rather than a mechanical include fix -- the packed gpu:: types are consumed at four call sites inside world_batch_runtime.cpp's interaction-broadphase path (not a single incidental reference), so closing this entry requires the GPU/engine integration seam itself to exist first. Deferred to T4 (Exact-runtime alignment)/the next T3 physical-split slice; not attempted this iteration to keep the write set bounded to the low-risk subset.

Deferred to T4 (Exact-runtime alignment)/the next T3 physical-split slice; not attempted this iteration to keep the write set bounded to the low-risk subset.
